purpose: Redacted read-only evidence for the physical iPad to Mac TestFlight 7 Production sync scenario on 2026-11-10.

collection.method: Official devicectl exact-bundle version query and appDataContainer read-only copies; no app launch, installation, reset, or cloud write.
collection.scope: VN Reader only; no account identifiers, device identifiers, tokens, raw engine data, or private-container paths are included.
collection.limitation: The installed iPad CloudKit entitlement was not directly inspected. TestFlight update was confirmed by the user; the Production environment on Mac was verified separately.

privateEngineFormatInference.limitation: These counts and timestamps were inferred from Apple's opaque persisted keyed-archive format. They are diagnostic observations, not public API guarantees or proof that a remote device applied the progress.

subsequentMacObservation.source: Root agent's native UI verification after a fresh sync; not inferred from iPad engine state.

conclusion: The iPad had persisted and captured page 8 before the Mac visibly received it. This round demonstrates eventual reverse progress delivery; it does not establish an immediate-sync latency guarantee.
